patch.objective: Common cybersecurity threats and their business impact: DDoS, ransomware, cryptomining, malware, phishing, misconfiguration, unsecured third-party systems, physical damage, LLM attacks

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Cloud Digital Leader certification exam guide: six sections at about 16-17% each, including Trust and Security with Google Cloud (~17%) and Scaling with Google Cloud Operations (~17%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16. Relevant text: 5.1 'Describe today's top cybersecurity threats and business implications'; 6.2 'Define key cloud reliability, DevOps, and SRE terms.' The page shows no version or date and does not name SLIs, SLOs or misconfiguration; the objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Storage: Public access prevention (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: it 'protects Cloud Storage buckets and objects from being accidentally exposed to the public'; existing allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers grants 'remain in place but are overridden'; it can be enforced with the organization policy constraint storage.publicAccessPrevention; signed URLs 'are not affected by public access prevention'.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Audit Logs overview (last updated 2026-11-12)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: 'Except for BigQuery, Data Access audit logs are disabled by default'; 'Publicly available resources that have the Identity and Access Management policies allAuthenticatedUsers or allUsers don't generate audit logs.' So nobody can list who read a public object.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Storage: Uniform bucket-level access (last updated 2026-10-30)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: 'Access Control Lists (ACLs) are disabled'; 'Requests to set, read, or modify bucket and object ACLs fail with 400 Bad Request errors.'

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Storage: Signed URLs (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: signed URLs 'give time-limited access to a specific Cloud Storage resource'; 'The longest expiration value is 604800 seconds (7 days).'

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Storage: Object Lifecycle Management (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: 'The Delete action deletes an object when the object meets all conditions'; 'The age condition is satisfied when a resource reaches the specified age (in days)'; actions run asynchronously, and 'Changes to a bucket's lifecycle configuration can take up to 24 hours to go into effect.'
